source_text: Opponents contend that neonatal circumcision exemplifies parental or institutional overreach, imposing a non-consensual, indelible modification on a non-autonomous individual whose body autonomy is thereby preempted without recourse, akin to other irreversible pediatric interventions but amplified by genital specificity. [7]
